_README: Multi-Agent Supervisor (MAS) config — re-creatable via `databricks supervisor-agents create-supervisor-agent` then `create-tool` once per tool. The MAS endpoint is what the Databricks App's `ask_data` tool talks to (config/app.json → masEndpointName).

supervisor_agent.description: Routes returns-investigation questions to Genie (data) and KA (incident reports)
supervisor_agent.instructions: You answer questions from Claire, VP Ops at LuxeBeauty. Route data/SQL questions to the data_analyst tool (Genie). Route manufacturing incident / equipment / QC report questions to the incident_expert tool (KA). For multi-part questions, call both and synthesize. Quote the incident summary verbatim when you have it. Keep answers short — lead with the number.

tools.description: Use for questions about manufacturing incidents, QC reports, equipment, calibration — answers from PIR / QC / maintenance PDFs
Use for any data/SQL question — returns, products, lots, customers, revenue, premium-cohort splits
